description.text: My First Battle, launched on 29 September 2023 as a first step into the game: two boxes, Pikachu & Bulbasaur and Charmander & Squirtle, each with two 17-card mini decks, two playmats, a rule book, a large metallic coin, damage counters and six Prize tokens. It plays a simpler game: players start with three cards in hand, and the first to Knock Out three of the opponent's Pokémon wins. The cards carry no set code or number, mark their deck with a silhouette of its lead Pokémon, and leave out Weakness, Resistance and Retreat Cost. This set holds all four decks; Potion and Switch are the only Trainers in each.
